title.en: a saturday night with the football on.

line.en: rain and 5 degrees, so a pub with screens. no confirmed bayern match today (it was friday); ask which game they put on.
line.de: regen und 5 grad, also eine kneipe mit bildschirmen. heute kein bestätigtes bayern-spiel (das war freitag); frag, welches spiel läuft.
line.tr: yağmur ve 5 derece, ekranlı bir pub iyi gelir. bugün onaylı bir bayern maçı yok (cuma oynandı); hangi maçın açık olduğunu sor.

sparks.why: Bayern–Köln was Fri 20.11 20:30 per most sources; no confirmed match found for Sat 21.11, so a generic pub spark. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a covered grill, if you must.
title.de: ein grill unterm dach, wenn es sein muss.

line.en: rain and 5 degrees. only with a roof over the grill; sausages, a thermos, an hour. otherwise cook at home.
line.de: regen und 5 grad. nur mit dach überm grill; würstchen, thermoskanne, eine stunde. sonst koch zu hause.
line.tr: yağmur ve 5 derece. mangalın üstünde çatı yoksa olmaz; sosis, termos, bir saat. yoksa evde pişirin.

sparks.why: Wet and cold, so outdoor grilling is marginal. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a wet walk in the forstenrieder park.
title.de: ein nasser gang durch den forstenrieder park.

line.en: rain, 5 degrees, soft ground. rain jackets, flat paths, home before the dark at half past four.
line.de: regen, 5 grad, weicher boden. regenjacke an, flache wege, vor der dunkelheit um halb fünf zurück.
line.tr: yağmur, 5 derece, yumuşak zemin. yağmurluk, düz yollar, dörtbuçukta hava kararmadan dönün.

sparks.why: Rainy and cold, flat forest paths only; sunset about 16:30. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a grey sunrise, or none.
title.tr: gri bir gün doğumu, ya da hiç.

line.en: sunrise is around 07:20 behind thick cloud and rain. only for the stubborn; go to the olympiaberg with a thermos.
line.de: sonnenaufgang gegen 07:20 hinter dicken wolken und regen. nur für sture; mit thermoskanne auf den olympiaberg.
line.tr: gün doğumu 07:20 civarı, kalın bulut ve yağmur arkasında. sadece inatçılar için; termosla olympiaberg'e çıkın.

sparks.why: Sunrise approx. 07:20 (estimated, not checked against an almanac); start set about 20 min before. Rain makes this a long shot. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a long saturday breakfast indoors.
title.de: ein langes frühstück am samstag, drinnen.

line.en: rain outside, so take the long table and stay until noon. glockenbach and haidhausen have the good ones.
line.de: draußen regen, also der lange tisch und bleiben bis mittag. im glockenbach und in haidhausen gibt es die guten.
line.tr: dışarıda yağmur, uzun bir masa tutun ve öğlene kadar kalın. glockenbach ve haidhausen'da iyileri var.

sparks.why: Saturday morning, rain all day. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a roof, but a closed one.

line.en: no rooftop in rain and 5 degrees. go up the olympiaturm instead and watch the city go dark at half past four.
line.de: kein dachbar-wetter bei regen und 5 grad. fahr lieber auf den olympiaturm und sieh der stadt beim dunkelwerden zu.
line.tr: yağmurda ve 5 derecede çatı barı olmaz. onun yerine olympiaturm'a çıkın, şehrin dörtbuçukta kararışını izleyin.

sparks.why: Rain, cold, sunset about 16:30; open-air rooftops are out so an indoor viewpoint. Opening hours not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a warm pool on a cold night.
title.de: ein warmes becken an einem kalten abend.
title.tr: soğuk bir akşamda sıcak bir havuz.

line.en: 5 degrees and rain, so the isar is out. the müller'sches volksbad is a hall with warm water and old tiles.
line.de: 5 grad und regen, die isar fällt aus. das müller'sche volksbad ist eine halle mit warmem wasser und alten fliesen.
line.tr: 5 derece ve yağmur, isar'a girilmez. müller'sches volksbad sıcak sulu, eski çinili bir salon.

sparks.why: Too cold for open water, so an indoor pool; opening hours on Saturday not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a pub quiz out of the rain.

line.en: saturday night, rain, a team of four. find a pub with a quiz and bring a pen.
line.de: samstagabend, regen, ein team aus vier. such dir eine kneipe mit quiz und bring einen stift mit.
line.tr: cumartesi gecesi, yağmur, dört kişilik takım. quiz yapan bir pub bulun, kalem getirin.

sparks.why: Generic indoor quiz night for a rainy Saturday; no specific quiz confirmed. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a place you have not been yet.
title.de: ein ort, an dem du noch nicht warst.

line.en: pick a bar or café in a district you never go to and go there in the rain. umbrella, no plan.
line.de: such dir eine bar oder ein café in einem viertel aus, in das du nie gehst, und geh bei regen hin. schirm, kein plan.
line.tr: hiç gitmediğin bir semtte bir bar ya da kafe seç ve yağmurda git. şemsiye, plan yok.

sparks.why: Generic kind; indoors because of rain. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a grey day for the camera.
title.de: ein grauer tag für die kamera.

line.en: wet streets and low light make good pictures. take the camera along the isar and under the bridges before dark.
line.de: nasse straßen und weiches licht machen gute bilder. kamera mit, an die isar und unter die brücken, vor der dunkelheit.
line.tr: ıslak sokaklar ve alçak ışık güzel kareler verir. kamerayı alıp karanlıktan önce isar boyunca köprülerin altına gidin.

sparks.why: Overcast and rainy, which suits moody street photography. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: the christkindlmarkt at marienplatz.

line.en: the market opened yesterday and runs to 24 december. mulled wine in the rain under the town hall; the residenz christmas village is nearby.
line.de: der markt hat gestern geöffnet und läuft bis 24. dezember. glühwein im regen vorm rathaus; das weihnachtsdorf in der residenz ist nah.
line.tr: pazar dün açıldı ve 24 aralık'a kadar sürüyor. yağmurda belediye binasının önünde sıcak şarap; residenz weihnachtsdorf yakın.

sparks.why: Christkindlmarkt Marienplatz runs 20.11-24.12, Weihnachtsdorf Residenz 16.11-22.12 (munich.travel, muenchen.de). Tollwood only opens 24.11.

title.en: a karaoke night to sing the rain away.
title.tr: yağmuru şarkıyla kovan bir karaoke gecesi.

line.en: saturday night, rain, a room with a microphone. pick a bar with a booth and put your name on the list early.
line.de: samstagabend, regen, ein raum mit mikrofon. such eine bar mit kabine und trag dich früh in die liste ein.
line.tr: cumartesi gecesi, yağmur, mikrofonlu bir oda. kabinli bir bar seçin, listeye erken yazılın.

sparks.why: Generic indoor night; no specific venue verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: an afternoon in the record shops.

line.en: rain, so crate-dig: the shops around gärtnerplatz and glockenbach, an hour each, one record each.
line.de: regen, also kisten wühlen: die läden rund um gärtnerplatz und glockenbach, je eine stunde, je eine platte.
line.tr: yağmur var, o zaman plak karıştırın: gärtnerplatz ve glockenbach çevresindeki dükkânlar, her birinde bir saat, bir plak.

sparks.why: Saturday shops are open (not a holiday); rain makes it an indoor kind. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: no open air today, only a roof.
title.de: heute kein open air, nur ein dach.
title.tr: bugün açık hava yok, sadece çatı.

line.en: rain and 5 degrees. skip the park; a covered market stall or a warm hall with live music works better.
line.de: regen und 5 grad. lass den park, ein überdachter marktstand oder eine warme halle mit livemusik passt besser.
line.tr: yağmur ve 5 derece. parkı boş verin; kapalı bir pazar tezgâhı ya da canlı müzikli sıcak bir salon daha iyi.

sparks.why: Open-air is unrealistic in November rain; no specific open-air event found. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a short ride in rain gear.

line.en: wet cobbles and 5 degrees, so keep it to the isar path from the deutsches museum to the flaucher. lights on, back by four.
line.de: nasse pflastersteine und 5 grad, also nur der isarweg vom deutschen museum zum flaucher. licht an, um vier zurück.
line.tr: ıslak parke taşları ve 5 derece, o yüzden deutsches museum'dan flaucher'e isar yolu yeter. ışıklar açık, dörtte dönün.

sparks.why: Rain and cold: short, familiar route only; dark by about 16:30. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a film in a dry seat.

line.en: the best saturday for it. pick an arthouse cinema, the 19:30 show, and walk home through the rain after.
line.de: der beste samstag dafür. such dir ein programmkino, die vorstellung um 19:30, und lauf danach im regen heim.
line.tr: tam sırası. bir sanat sineması seçin, 19:30 seansı, sonra yağmurda yürüyerek eve dönün.

sparks.why: Rainy Saturday evening; specific programme not checked. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: board games and something warm to drink.
title.de: brettspiele und etwas warmes zu trinken.
title.tr: kutu oyunları ve sıcak bir içecek.

line.en: rain all day. take a café with a shelf of games, order a pot of tea and settle in for the evening.
line.de: den ganzen tag regen. such dir ein café mit spieleregal, bestell eine kanne tee und bleib den abend.
line.tr: gün boyu yağmur. oyun rafı olan bir kafe bulun, bir demlik çay söyleyin, akşam orada kalın.

sparks.why: Generic indoor kind for a wet Saturday. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a flea market in wet shoes.

line.en: outdoor flea markets are thin in november rain. try the ms-bazar at the mvg museum, 21 and 22 november, under a roof.
line.de: freiluft-flohmärkte sind im novemberregen dünn besetzt. probier den ms-bazar im mvg museum, 21. und 22. november, unter dach.
line.tr: açık hava bit pazarları kasım yağmurunda zayıf kalır. çatı altında mvg museum'daki ms-bazar'a bakın, 21 ve 22 kasım.

sparks.why: MS-Bazar at the MVG Museum 21-22.11 (munich.travel); hours not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: skate where the roof is.

line.en: wet concrete is no fun. find a covered spot or an indoor hall, or save it for a dry day.
line.de: nasser beton macht keinen spaß. such einen überdachten spot oder eine halle, oder heb es dir für einen trockenen tag auf.
line.tr: ıslak beton keyif vermez. kapalı bir nokta ya da salon bulun, yoksa kuru bir güne bırakın.

sparks.why: Rain makes outdoor skating poor; no specific venue verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: cook together while it rains.

line.en: everyone brings one thing and the kitchen does the rest. soup or pasta for six, at someone's place, from half past six.
line.de: jeder bringt eine sache mit, den rest macht die küche. suppe oder nudeln für sechs, bei jemandem zu hause, ab halb sieben.
line.tr: herkes bir şey getirsin, gerisini mutfak halleder. altı kişilik çorba ya da makarna, birinin evinde, altıbuçuktan itibaren.

sparks.why: Generic indoor kind for a wet evening. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a sauna after the cold rain.
title.de: eine sauna nach dem kalten regen.

line.en: 5 degrees and wet is the day for it. the olympia schwimmhalle has a sauna; take a towel, stay two rounds.
line.de: 5 grad und nass, dafür ist der tag gemacht. die olympia-schwimmhalle hat eine sauna; handtuch mit, zwei durchgänge.
line.tr: 5 derece ve ıslak, tam günü. olympia-schwimmhalle'de sauna var; havlu alın, iki tur kalın.

sparks.why: Cold, wet day suits a sauna; opening hours and sauna availability not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: an open mic, rain or not.
title.de: ein open mic, egal ob regen.

line.en: a saturday night room with a sign-up sheet. sing or just listen with a beer in the back.
line.de: ein raum am samstagabend mit anmeldeliste. sing oder hör hinten mit einem bier zu.
line.tr: cumartesi gecesi bir salon, bir kayıt listesi. şarkı söyleyin ya da arkada birayla dinleyin.

sparks.why: Generic indoor kind; no specific open mic confirmed. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: table tennis in the dry.

line.en: rain, so no park tables. find a bar or club with a table and play to eleven, winner buys.
line.de: regen, also keine parktische. such eine bar oder einen verein mit tisch und spiel bis elf, der sieger zahlt.
line.tr: yağmur var, park masaları yok. masası olan bir bar ya da kulüp bulun, on bire kadar oynayın, kazanan ısmarlar.

sparks.why: Outdoor park tables unusable in rain; no specific venue verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: bouldering, because the wall is dry.
title.de: bouldern, denn die wand ist trocken.

line.en: 5 degrees and rain, so the halls are full but the walls are dry. take chalk, book a slot and warm up properly.
line.de: 5 grad und regen, die hallen sind voll, aber die wände trocken. magnesia mit, slot buchen und richtig aufwärmen.
line.tr: 5 derece ve yağmur, salonlar dolu ama duvarlar kuru. magnezyum alın, saat ayırtın, iyice ısının.

sparks.why: Indoor sport for a wet day; hall not specified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: an indoor picnic, honestly.

line.en: no blanket in the park today. spread it on a floor at home or in a museum café and share what you brought.
line.de: heute keine decke im park. breit sie zu hause oder in einem museumscafé aus und teilt, was ihr mitgebracht habt.
line.tr: bugün parkta örtü yok. evde ya da bir müze kafesinde örtüyü serin, getirdiklerinizi paylaşın.

sparks.why: Rain and 5°C rule out a park picnic. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a short bar crawl, three stops.
title.tr: kısa bir bar turu, üç durak.

line.en: keep it close so the rain doesn't matter: three bars within five minutes of each other, one drink each, around gärtnerplatz.
line.de: bleib nah, damit der regen egal ist: drei bars, fünf minuten auseinander, je ein getränk, rund um den gärtnerplatz.
line.tr: yakın tutun ki yağmur sorun olmasın: gärtnerplatz çevresinde birbirine beş dakika uzaklıkta üç bar, her birinde bir içki.

sparks.why: Rainy Saturday night, short walking distances. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: no stars tonight, so a planetarium.
title.de: heute keine sterne, also ein planetarium.
title.tr: bu gece yıldız yok, planetaryum var.

line.en: thick cloud and rain hide the sky. the deutsches museum has the planetarium; check the evening show before you go.
line.de: dicke wolken und regen verdecken den himmel. das deutsche museum hat das planetarium; schau vorher nach der abendvorstellung.
line.tr: kalın bulut ve yağmur gökyüzünü kapatıyor. deutsches museum'da planetaryum var; gitmeden akşam seansına bakın.

sparks.why: Overcast and rainy, no star-gazing; planetarium schedule not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a kickabout in the hall.

line.en: pitches are mud and 5 degrees. rent an indoor court or hall for an hour; five-a-side, then a beer.
line.de: die plätze sind matsch und 5 grad. miete eine halle oder einen court für eine stunde; fünf gegen fünf, dann ein bier.
line.tr: sahalar çamur, hava 5 derece. bir saatlik kapalı saha kiralayın; beşe beş, sonra bir bira.

sparks.why: Wet pitches, so indoor five-a-side; no specific hall verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a ride on the number 19.

line.en: rain makes the tram the best seat in town. ride the 19 from the hauptbahnhof to the maxmonument and see the lights come on.
line.de: bei regen ist die tram der beste platz der stadt. fahr mit der 19 vom hauptbahnhof zum maxmonument und sieh die lichter angehen.
line.tr: yağmurda tramvay şehrin en iyi koltuğu. 19'a hauptbahnhof'tan binip maxmonument'e gidin, ışıkların yanışını izleyin.

sparks.why: Rainy day, dark from about 16:30; the line 19 route is a known scenic one but check the day's timetable. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a jazz night in a warm cellar.

line.en: saturday night, rain, a low room with a trio. go to the unterfahrt in haidhausen; check the programme and bring cash.
line.de: samstagabend, regen, ein niedriger raum mit trio. geh in die unterfahrt in haidhausen; schau ins programm und bring bargeld mit.
line.tr: cumartesi gecesi, yağmur, trolu alçak tavanlı bir salon. haidhausen'daki unterfahrt'a gidin; programa bakın, nakit alın.

sparks.why: Unterfahrt is a well-known jazz club; tonight's programme not verified. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).

title.en: a walk under an umbrella.

line.en: the english garden in rain is nearly empty. walk to the monopteros before the dark, then warm up with soup.
line.de: der englische garten im regen ist fast leer. lauf zum monopteros, bevor es dunkel wird, und wärm dich danach mit suppe auf.
line.tr: yağmurda englischer garten neredeyse boş. hava kararmadan monopteros'a yürüyün, sonra çorbayla ısının.

sparks.why: Rain and 5°C, dark at about 16:30; an easy short walk. Forecast: rain, 4-6°C all day (muenchen.de, wetter.com).
